endpoints.name: Site Users
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/users?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:sites,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&authors_only={Fetch Authors Only?:true|false}&type={Post Type?}&search={Search Text?}&search_columns={Search Columns?,:ID,user_login,user_email,...}&role={User Role?}
endpoints.description: The users of one site, with their roles and capabilities. Requires a site.

endpoints.name: Site User
endpoints.description: One site user by login. Requires the site.

endpoints.name: Current User Metadata
endpoints.description: The authenticated account's profile -- name, email, avatar and primary blog. One record, always the caller.

endpoints.name: Current User Billing History
endpoints.description: The caller's purchase history on WordPress.com -- plans, domains and upgrades bought. The commercial record, which no site endpoint carries.

endpoints.name: Current User Settings
endpoints.description: The caller's account settings.

endpoints.name: Current User Preferences
endpoints.description: The caller's interface preferences.

endpoints.name: Current User Profile Links
endpoints.description: The links on the caller's public profile.

endpoints.name: Current User Connected Applications
endpoints.description: The third-party applications authorised against the caller's account. Security inventory.

endpoints.name: Current User Connected Application
endpoints.description: One connected application by id.

endpoints.name: Current User Likes
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/me/likes?meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&after={Dated On or After?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&before={Dated On or Before?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}
endpoints.description: The posts the caller has liked across WordPress.com.

endpoints.name: Site Shortcodes
endpoints.description: The shortcodes available on one site. Content embedded through these is invisible in raw post content, which is worth knowing when post text seems incomplete.

endpoints.name: Site Embeds
endpoints.description: The embed providers one site supports.

endpoints.name: Site
endpoints.description: One site's details -- name, description, URL, post count, subscriber count, language, and the plan and features it has. THIS IS THE WORDPRESS.COM API, not the REST API of a self-hosted install: it serves WordPress.com sites and self-hosted ones connected through Jetpack, and a plain self-hosted WordPress is not reachable through it at all. Every endpoint here takes a site id or domain.

endpoints.name: Site Page Templates
endpoints.description: The page templates the site's theme offers.

endpoints.name: Site Post Types
endpoints.description: The post types registered on one site -- post, page, and any custom ones. Requires a site. What kinds of content exist, which the post listing's default hides.

endpoints.name: Site Post Counts by Type
endpoints.suffix: /v1.2/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/post-counts/{Post Type}?meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}
endpoints.description: How many posts of one type exist, by status. Requires the site and post type. The cheap count, broken out by draft, published and trashed.

endpoints.name: Site Widgets
endpoints.description: The widgets configured on one site.

endpoints.name: Site WordAds Settings
endpoints.description: The advertising configuration of one site.

endpoints.name: Site WordAds Earnings
endpoints.description: Advertising earnings by period. The revenue side of running ads.

endpoints.name: Site WordAds TOS
endpoints.description: Whether the site has accepted the advertising terms. Ads do not run until it has, which explains zero earnings on a configured site.

endpoints.name: Site WordAds Statistics
endpoints.description: Advertising impressions and revenue for one site over a period. Only meaningful where WordAds is enabled.

endpoints.name: Current User Sites

endpoints: Site Views by Tag and Category

endpoints.description: The sites the authenticated user can access. The starting point, since everything else needs a site.

endpoints.name: Site Widget
endpoints.description: One widget by id.

endpoints.name: Site Theme Headers
endpoints.description: The header images available for one theme. Requires the site and theme slug.

endpoints.name: Site Headers
endpoints.description: The header images in use on one site.

endpoints.name: Post by ID
endpoints.description: One post by id. Requires the site.

endpoints.name: Post by Slug
endpoints.description: One post by its URL slug. Requires the site. The route in when only the public URL is known.

endpoints.name: Search Posts
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/posts?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&after={Dated On or After?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&before={Dated On or Before?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&modified_after={Modified On or After?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&modified_before={Modified On or Before?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&tag={Tag Name or Slug?}&category={Category Name or Slug?}&term={Term Slugs?:term1,term2,...}&type={Post Type?}&parent_id={Parent Post ID?}&exclude={Exclude Post IDs?,:id1,id2,...}&exclude_tree={Exclude Post Tree ID?}&status={Statuses?:publish,private,draft,any,...}&sticky={Sticky?:include|exclude|require}&author={Author ID?}&search={Search Term?}&meta_key={Metadata Key?}&meta_value={Metadata Value?}
endpoints.description: The posts of one site, filterable by status, type, author, category, tag, search term and date. Requires a site. THE MAIN CONTENT TABLE. Carries title, content, excerpt, status, the author, date and modified date, categories, tags, and the counts of likes and comments. NOTE THE DEFAULT: only PUBLISHED posts of type post are returned, so drafts, pages and custom post types are absent unless asked for -- which quietly excludes most of a site's content on anything but a simple blog.

endpoints.name: Current User Posts
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/me/posts?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&author={Author ID?}&after={Dated On or After?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&before={Dated On or Before?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&modified_after={Modified On or After?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&modified_before={Modified On or Before?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&type={Post Type?}&status={Statuses?:publish,private,draft,any,...}&search={Search Text?}&lang={Search Language?}&sites={Site IDs?:id1,id2,...}&site_visibility={Site Visibility?:all|visible|hidden}
endpoints.description: The posts the caller has written across their sites.

endpoints.name: Post Likes
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/posts/{Post ID}/likes?meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}
endpoints.description: Who liked one post. Requires the site and post id. The post carries a like count; this is who they were.

endpoints.name: Current User Post Like Status
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/posts/{Post ID}/likes/mine?meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}
endpoints.description: Whether the caller has liked one post.

endpoints.name: Post Subscribers
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/posts/{Post ID}/subscribers?meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}
endpoints.description: Who subscribed to one post's comments. Requires the site and post id.

endpoints.name: Current User Post Subscription Status
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/posts/{Post ID}/subscribers/mine?meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}
endpoints.description: Whether the caller subscribes to one post.

endpoints.name: Current User Post Reblog Status
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/posts/{Post ID}/reblogs/mine?meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}
endpoints.description: Whether the caller has reblogged one post.

endpoints.name: Comment
endpoints.description: One comment by id. Requires the site.

endpoints.name: Recent Comments
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/comments?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&hierarchical={Hierarchical?:true|false}&after={Dated On or After?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&before={Dated On or Before?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&type={Type?:any|comment|trackback|pingback|pings}&status={Status?:approved|unapproved|spam|trash|all}
endpoints.description: The comments on one site, filterable by status. Requires a site. Carries the author, content, date, the post commented on, and the approval status. STATUS MATTERS: unapproved, spam and trashed comments share this table with approved ones, so an engagement count that does not filter includes spam.

endpoints.name: Post Recent Comments
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/posts/{Post ID}/replies?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&hierarchical={Hierarchical?:true|false}&after={Dated On or After?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&before={Dated On or Before?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&type={Type?:any|comment|trackback|pingback|pings}&status={Status?:approved|unapproved|spam|trash|all}
endpoints.description: The comments on one post. Requires the site and post id.

endpoints.name: Comment Counts
endpoints.description: Comment counts by status for one site. Requires a site. The ready-made summary, and it separates approved from spam without paging anything.

endpoints.name: Comment Audit History
endpoints.description: The moderation history of one comment -- approvals, spam marks and edits. Requires the site and comment id. Why a comment is in its current state, which the comment itself does not say.

endpoints.name: Comment Likes
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/comments/{Comment ID}/likes?meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}
endpoints.description: Who liked one comment. Requires the site and comment id.

endpoints.name: Current User Comment Like Status
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/comments/{Comment ID}/likes/mine?meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}
endpoints.description: Whether the caller has liked one comment.

endpoints.name: Site Categories
endpoints.description: The categories of one site, with post counts. Requires a site. The primary content taxonomy.

endpoints.name: Site Tags
endpoints.description: The tags of one site, with post counts. Requires a site. The secondary, free-form taxonomy.

endpoints.name: Site Category
endpoints.description: One category by slug. Requires the site.

endpoints.name: Site Tag
endpoints.description: One tag by slug. Requires the site.

endpoints.name: Taxonomy Term
endpoints.description: One taxonomy term by slug. Requires the site and taxonomy.

endpoints.name: Post Type Taxonomies
endpoints.description: The taxonomies attached to one post type. Requires the site and post type. CUSTOM POST TYPES BRING THEIR OWN TAXONOMIES, so categories and tags are not the whole classification on a site that uses them.

endpoints.name: Taxonomy Terms
endpoints.description: The terms of one taxonomy. Requires the site and taxonomy. The generalised version of categories and tags.

endpoints.name: Site Followers
endpoints.description: The followers of one site. Requires a site. The audience list behind the follower count.

endpoints.name: Current User Blog Following Status
endpoints.description: Whether the caller follows one site.

endpoints.name: Sharing Buttons
endpoints.description: The sharing buttons configured on one site.

endpoints.name: External Services
endpoints.description: The external services WordPress.com can connect to. Reference data.

endpoints.name: External Service
endpoints.description: One external service by name.

endpoints.name: Current User Publicize Connections
endpoints.description: The caller's own social publishing connections.

endpoints.name: Current User Publicize Connection
endpoints.description: One of the caller's publicize connections by id.

endpoints.name: Current User Keyring Connections
endpoints.description: The caller's underlying authorisations to external services. The credential layer beneath publicize connections.

endpoints.name: Current User Keyring Connection
endpoints.description: One keyring connection by id.

endpoints.name: Site Publicize Connections
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/publicize-connections?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&service={Service?}&user_id={User ID?}&keyring_connection_ID={Keyring Connection ID?}
endpoints.description: The social accounts one site auto-publishes to. Requires a site. Where a post reaches beyond the site itself.

endpoints.name: Site Publicize Connection
endpoints.description: One site publicize connection by id.

endpoints.name: External Services with Sharing Buttons
endpoints.description: The services available as sharing buttons. Reference data.

endpoints.name: Insights List
endpoints.description: The insight reports available. WordPress.com's own prepared analyses, as opposed to the raw statistics.

endpoints.name: Insights Data
endpoints.description: One insight report by slug.

endpoints.name: Default Reader Menu
endpoints.description: The Reader's default menu structure. Interface configuration.

endpoints.name: Feed
endpoints.description: One feed by URL or id, with its recent posts.

endpoints.name: Followed Blog Posts
endpoints.description: The posts from sites the caller follows. The Reader feed -- consumption rather than publishing.

endpoints.name: Liked Blog Posts
endpoints.description: The posts the caller has liked, as a feed.

endpoints.name: Tagged Posts
endpoints.description: Recent posts carrying one tag, across WordPress.com. Requires the tag. Cross-site content discovery, unlike Site Tags which is one site's own taxonomy.

endpoints.name: Subscribed Tags
endpoints.description: The tags the caller follows in the Reader.

endpoints.name: Trending Tags
endpoints.description: The tags trending across WordPress.com. A snapshot with no history behind it.

endpoints.name: Tag
endpoints.description: One Reader tag by name, with its post count.

endpoints.name: Tag Subscription Status
endpoints.description: Whether the caller follows one tag.

endpoints.name: Followed Feeds
endpoints.description: The feeds the caller follows.

endpoints.name: Feed Search
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/read/feed?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&url={Site Domain or URL?}&q={Query Text?}&exclude_followed={Exclude Already Followed Sites?:true|false}
endpoints.description: Feeds matching a query. Discovery within the Reader.

endpoints.name: Recommended Blogs
endpoints.description: Blogs WordPress.com recommends to the caller. Algorithmic suggestion rather than data.

endpoints.name: Site Statistics
endpoints.description: The headline traffic figures for one site over a period -- views, visitors, likes and comments. Requires a site. THE WORDPRESS.COM STATS SYSTEM, which is separate from the content tables and computed independently: a post's view count comes from here rather than from the post record.

endpoints.name: Site Summary Statistics
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/stats/summary?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&num={Number of Periods?}&period={Period?:day|week|month|year}&date={Most Recent Period Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}&offset={Time Zone Offset?}
endpoints.description: The site's aggregate figures for a period -- views, visitors, best-ever day and totals. The overview.

endpoints.name: Site Top Post Statistics
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/stats/top-posts?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&num={Number of Periods?}&period={Period?:day|week|month|year}&date={Most Recent Day to Include?:yyyy-MM-dd}&max={Maximum Number of Results?}&offset={Time Zone Offset?}&summarize={Summarize Data?:true|false}
endpoints.description: The most-viewed posts over a period, with their view counts. Which content actually earned the traffic.

endpoints.name: Video Post Statistics
endpoints.description: The play statistics of one video post.

endpoints.name: Site Referrer Statistics
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/stats/referrers?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&num={Number of Periods?}&period={Period?:day|week|month|year}&date={Most Recent Day to Include?:yyyy-MM-dd}&max={Maximum Number of Results?}&offset={Time Zone Offset?}&summary={Summarize Data?:true|false}
endpoints.description: Where traffic came from over a period, by referring site. The acquisition table.

endpoints.name: Site Outbound Click Statistics
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/stats/clicks?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&num={Number of Periods?}&period={Period?:day|week|month|year}&date={Most Recent Day to Include?:yyyy-MM-dd}&max={Maximum Number of Results?}&offset={Time Zone Offset?}&summary={Summarize Data?:true|false}
endpoints.description: The outbound links visitors clicked, over a period. Where readers went next -- which no view count reveals.

endpoints.name: Site Views by Tag and Category
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/stats/tags?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&max={Maximum Number of Results?}
endpoints.description: Traffic by taxonomy term over a period. Which subjects draw readers, as opposed to which individual posts.

endpoints.name: Site Top Author Statistics
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/stats/top-authors?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&num={Number of Periods?}&period={Period?:day|week|month|year}&date={Most Recent Day to Include?:yyyy-MM-dd}&max={Maximum Number of Results?}&offset={Time Zone Offset?}
endpoints.description: Views by author over a period. Per-writer performance on a multi-author site.

endpoints.name: Site Top Comment Statistics
endpoints.description: The most-commented posts and the most active commenters over a period.

endpoints.name: Site Video Plays Statistics
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/stats/video-plays?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&num={Number of Periods?}&period={Period?:day|week|month|year}&date={Most Recent Day to Include?:yyyy-MM-dd}&max={Maximum Number of Results?}&offset={Time Zone Offset?}
endpoints.description: Video plays across the site over a period.

endpoints.name: Site File Download Statistics
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/stats/file-downloads?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&num={Number of Periods?}&period={Period?:day|week|month|year}&date={Most Recent Day to Include?:yyyy-MM-dd}&max={Maximum Number of Results?}&offset={Time Zone Offset?}
endpoints.description: Downloads of files hosted on the site, over a period.

endpoints.name: Post View Statistics
endpoints.description: The view history of ONE post over time. Requires the site and post id. The per-post series, as opposed to a ranking snapshot.

endpoints.name: Site Views by Country
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/stats/country-views?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&num={Number of Periods?}&period={Period?:day|week|month|year}&date={Most Recent Day to Include?:yyyy-MM-dd}&max={Maximum Number of Results?}&offset={Time Zone Offset?}&summary={Summarize Data?:true|false}
endpoints.description: Traffic by country over a period.

endpoints.name: Site Follower Statistics
endpoints.description: The site's follower count over time, and the recent followers. Audience growth rather than traffic.

endpoints.name: Site Comment Follower Statistics
endpoints.description: Followers subscribed to comments rather than to posts.

endpoints.name: Site Publicize Follower Statistics
endpoints.description: Follower counts on the connected social accounts. Reach beyond the site itself.

endpoints.name: Site Search Term Statistics
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/stats/search-terms?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&num={Number of Periods?}&period={Period?:day|week|month|year}&date={Most Recent Day to Include?:yyyy-MM-dd}&max={Maximum Number of Results?}&offset={Time Zone Offset?}&summary={Summarize Data?:true|false}
endpoints.description: The search terms that brought visitors, over a period. NOTE most search engines withhold the term, so this table is heavily incomplete by design and its totals do not reconcile with search referral counts.

endpoints.name: Post Total View Statistics
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/stats/views/posts?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&num={Number of Days?:1-30}&post_ids={Post IDs:id1,id2,...}&date={Most Recent Day to Include?:yyyy-MM-dd}&offset={Time Zone Offset?}
endpoints.description: Lifetime view totals for the site's posts. The all-time ranking rather than a period one.

endpoints.name: Calendar Heatmap Statistics
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/stats/streak?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&startDate={Start Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}&endDate={End Date?:yyyy-MM-dd}&max={Maximum Number of Posts to Return?}
endpoints.description: Posting activity by day, as the data behind a contribution-style heatmap. Publishing cadence rather than readership.

endpoints.name: Media Item
endpoints.description: One media item by id.

endpoints.name: Media Items
endpoints.suffix: /v1.1/sites/{Site ID or Domain}/media?context={Context?:display|edit}&meta={Include Metadata?:site,likes,...}&fields={Include Fields?:ID,title,...}&search={Search Query?}&post_ID={Post ID?}&mime_type={MIME Type?}&after={Uploaded After?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}&before={Uploaded Before?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss}
endpoints.description: The media library of one site, with file name, type, dimensions, size, the post each is attached to and the upload date. Requires a site. Storage questions and unused-asset questions are answered here.

endpoints.name: Navigation Menu
endpoints.description: One menu by id.

endpoints.name: Navigation Menus
endpoints.description: The navigation menus of one site, with their items. The site's own structure as presented to readers.

endpoints.name: Video Metadata
endpoints.description: The metadata of one VideoPress video -- duration, dimensions and processing state. Requires a video id.

endpoints.name: Video Poster
endpoints.description: The poster image of one video.
